title: ChatGPT Just Stopped Answering With Only Text
description:
With GPT-6, ChatGPT's new Intelligent UI can answer with tappable buttons, forms, charts, maps and even small tools like a bill splitter or a savings calculator.
The interface is built while the answer is still being written. Paid plans got it on October 7, and Free and Go users from the next day.
